title: Equipment Handoff Report Form
subtitle: Equipment Handoff: reconciles results, variances, and follow-up.
description: Equipment Handoff Report Form covers equipment unit, accessory set, condition, configuration, custody, and return obligation. The equipment custody coordinator records Equipment Handoff source records, totals, variance, and distribution. Equipment Handoff Report Form keeps Equipment Handoff exceptions visible until the equipment custody coordinator handoff.
use_case: Use Equipment Handoff Report Form at issuing location, receiving location, transport path, and return point. Document equipment unit, accessory set, condition, configuration, custody, and return obligation identity before Equipment Handoff begins. Compare equipment unit, accessory set, condition, configuration, custody, and return obligation findings with stated Equipment Handoff criteria; route unresolved Equipment Handoff issues to asset-control reviewer. For Equipment Handoff Report Form, confirm requirements for Equipment Handoff. Ask asset-control reviewer to review Equipment Handoff conditions beyond the equipment custody coordinator's role.

sections.title: Report scope and responsible parties
sections.guidance: For Equipment Handoff, identify responsible parties, issuing location, receiving location, transport path, and return point, and the linked equipment unit, accessory set, condition, configuration, custody, and return obligation source.

fields.label: Asset tag, serial, model, and quantity
Accessory, key, credential, software, and configuration identifiers

sections.title: Report lines and recipient controls
sections.guidance: Capture Equipment Handoff facts for equipment unit, accessory set, condition, configuration, custody, and return obligation; include result, limit, source, and next control.

blocks.label: Equipment Handoff report checks
items: Custody date, location, and intended use
Return condition, due date, and unresolved defect

sections.title: Reconciled outcome and reviewer acknowledgment
sections.guidance: Resolve open Equipment Handoff conditions; have equipment custody coordinator assign the next Equipment Handoff owner and transfer its retained record.

blocks.label: Reconciliation exceptions and retained evidence
items: Unsafe or failed equipment cannot be released
blocks.guidance: Pause Equipment Handoff when authority, identity, condition, data protection, accessory accounting, or custody remains unresolved. Retain the available Equipment Handoff proof and route unresolved equipment unit, accessory set, condition, configuration, custody, and return obligation scope to equipment custody coordinator.
